title: BFZ Standard Series: card flavor text

entities.name: Murasa
entities.description: A continent beneath a blanket of dense vegetation, with enormous tangled branches so thick some inhabitants never see the ground.

entities.name: Akoum
entities.description: A volcanic continent where bizarre vegetation clusters around gas vents and jagged mountain peaks rise high.

entities.name: Ondu
entities.description: A continent that is a vast plateau crisscrossed by deep trenches and meandering rivers.

entities.name: Guul Draz
entities.description: A continent that is a geothermal swampland reeking of heat and decay.

entities.name: Tazeem
entities.description: A continent where rushing waters plunge through narrow canyons into mist-cloaked lakes.
